name: Shark Crisis
steps: Take the wooden board and place it over the hole.
Take the vines and tie them around the board.
Take the sail and use it to cover the leak.
Take the life vest and place it on the hole.
Take the coral piece and use it to block the leak.
Take the swimsuits and use them to seal the hole.
Tap the boat to check if the leak is fixed.
Keep using the items until the hole is fully sealed and the shark is stopped.
